title: dis2025
summary: A Korean-language data science course project containing scripts that generate synthetic tabular data for experimentation and comparison against real datasets. The scripts import SDV's single-table module, build a SingleTableMetadata object, and fit CTGANSynthesizer or GaussianCopulaSynthesizer models to produce synthetic samples, so SDV is run directly as the synthetic data generator.
needs: No README detail on the dataset domain or authorship; single-contributor course repo with minimal documentation.
